content_sections.heading: About the College
content_sections.text: ESIC College of Nursing is located at Indiranagar, Bengaluru. The notice invites lecturers for its B.Sc. Nursing first-year semesters, with eligibility set as per INC norms. The notice is signed by the Dean cum Principal, and the interview is held at the Academic Block of ESIC Medical College, PGIMSR & Model Hospital, Rajajinagar, Bengaluru.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Send the application by e-mail only to [email protected] . It must be in the prescribed format, complete in all respects (entries and the documents to be enclosed), with a photograph affixed on the application. It should reach the office on or before 28.11.2026 (Saturday) by 4 pm. Incomplete applications will be disqualified. The notice does not specify an e-mail subject line. The prescribed application format is printed on pages 4 and 5 of the notice, titled "Application for interviews for the post of Visiting/Part Time Lecturer for ESIC College of Nursing, Indiranagar, Bangalore". Tick the subject(s) applied for on the form: Communicative English / Applied Sociology / Kannada / Applied Psychology / Applied Nutrition and Dietetics. The form asks for name, father's/husband's name, mother's name, date of birth as per SSLC/10th certificate, religion, nationality, mobile number, e-mail ID (in capital letters), Aadhaar number, permanent address and correspondence address. It also asks for educational qualification (PG and UG), teaching experience, experience of teaching B.Sc. Nursing students in the respective subject, ability to teach in online mode (MS Teams / Zoom / Google Classroom etc.), and whether the candidate was ever dismissed or punished, followed by a declaration. For clarification, call the Principal on 080-29517958 / 9738643553 between 11.30 AM and 04.00 PM on working days, or write to [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: All five posts carry the same pay of Rs.1200/- per hour, paid at the end of the semester, with statutory deductions (TDS and PT). The remuneration includes the planning, preparation, conduct and evaluation of a minimum of 2 internal assessment tests, 2 written assignments, 2 seminars and 1 group project, for which no extra remuneration is paid or claimed. The total is 5 posts. The number of posts is provisional and may increase or decrease depending on actual requirement. Post-Graduation (MA/M.Sc.) and teaching experience in the respective subjects: Sociology / Kannada / English / Psychology and Applied Nutrition and Dietetics, as per INC norms. Preference will be given to those who have taught B.Sc. Nursing course students in the respective subject earlier. The candidate should be well versed with digital methods of teaching, such as PPT and LCD projectors, and able to take classes through offline and online mode as and when required. A candidate who has the required qualification in more than one of the subjects can apply for them in the same application, but the candidature will be considered for a maximum of two subjects. The age shall not exceed 67 years as on the date of interview, 03.12.2026, for all the posts. The notice gives 03.12.2026 as the crucial date for age, work experience and other eligibility criteria. Candidates should check the official notification for the subject-wise eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Two sets of self-attested, clearly legible photocopies must be sent with the application by e-mail. The originals must be produced for verification on the day of interview, compulsorily. The original set of the application form, complete in all respects, with photograph affixed, to be submitted on the interview day. Proof of date of birth: SSLC / 10th Standard Certificate or equivalent. Certificates of qualifications: degree certificates and year-wise marks list, UG and PG. Experience certificates. Aadhaar card copy. Two passport-size photographs with the application.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is purely based on performance in the interview conducted by the selection board. Candidates are shortlisted from the e-mail applications, intimated, interviewed in person, and the selected candidates are then informed. Eligible candidates shortlisted for the interview will be intimated on 01.12.2026 through e-mail and through the ESIC website. The interview is held in person on 03.12.2026 from 8.40 am at the Academic Block, ESIC Medical College, PGIMSR & Model Hospital, Rajajinagar, Bengaluru - 560010. Candidates reporting after 11.00 am will not be considered for interview. Each candidate presents one short (5 minutes) PowerPoint presentation related to the respective subject and must bring it on a pen drive. Selected candidates will be informed through e-mail, and the list will be published on the ESIC website. No query or correspondence will be entertained in this regard. The date of commencement of classes will be intimated to the selected candidates.

faq.question: Q1. How many posts are there in ESIC College of Nursing Indiranagar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 5 Visiting / Part Time Lecturer posts, one (UR) each in Kannada, Applied Sociology, Applied Psychology, Communicative English and Applied Nutrition and Dietetics. The number is provisional and may increase or decrease.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The application must reach the office by 4 pm on 28 November 2026 (Saturday), by e-mail only.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: Post-Graduation (MA/M.Sc.) and teaching experience in the respective subject, as per INC norms. Preference is given to those who have taught B.Sc. Nursing students in that subject earlier.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age shall not exceed 67 years as on the date of interview, 3 December 2026, for all the posts.

faq.question: Q5. How much is the remuneration?
faq.answer: Rs.1200/- per hour for theory, paid at the end of the semester, with statutory deductions (TDS and PT). It includes internal assessment tests, written assignments, seminars and a group project, with no extra remuneration.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Send the prescribed application form, complete in all respects with a photograph affixed, and two sets of self-attested photocopies to [email protected]. Applications are accepted by e-mail only.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Selection is purely on performance in the interview before the selection board. Each candidate gives a 5-minute PowerPoint presentation on the subject, to be brought on a pen drive.

faq.question: Q8. When and where is the interview?
faq.answer: The interview is on 3 December 2026 from 8.40 am at the Academic Block, ESIC Medical College, PGIMSR & Model Hospital, Rajajinagar, Bengaluru - 560010. Candidates reporting after 11.00 am will not be considered.

faq.question: Q9. Can I apply for more than one subject?
faq.answer: Yes, a candidate with the required qualification in more than one subject can apply in the same application, but the candidature will be considered for a maximum of two subjects.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent job, and is TA/DA paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No permanent post is mentioned; the engagement is purely hourly for the respective semesters of 2026-27 and can be ended by either side with one month's notice. No TA/DA is payable for appearing in the interview.
